summary: Full backend + frontend test of new Prototype stage. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass — CRUD for /api/prototype/graphs (create/list/get/patch/delete + invalid/notfound), Cloudinary /api/prototype/upload-mockup returns secure URL, /api/prototype/run returns 202 with batch_id/status='started'/stage='prototype'/persona_count/personas list, existing seeded graph 6a9364ae6d16f9e2217e4aa7 verified with name='Tier3 Pricing Flow', 3 screens, 3 transitions, start_screen='homepage'. Regression: /api/health, /api/persona-panels, /api/runs all still 200. Frontend: /prototype loads with Prototype Studio heading; Screens/Transitions/Run prototype test sections all present; nav 'Prototype' link present; graph selector shows 'New graph' + 'Tier3 Pricing Flow'; loading Tier3 renders 3 screen-card-* nodes and populates graph-name-input; Add screen creates cards; Add transition creates row with from/label/to; Run button disabled when goal empty and enabled with goal + graph loaded; Save graph produces 'Graph saved' toast (API POST 200).
critical_code_review_comments: prototype_run endpoint's test spawns a background LLM run each time it is invoked (consumes EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + Cloudinary). Consider adding a `dry_run` flag on POST /api/prototype/run that returns 202 without launching the panel task — useful for CI/e2e.

server.py is 1156 lines and covers spike, engine, panel, prototype, generator, signals, and 4 CRUD resources — should be split into routers (prototype_router.py, engine_router.py, crud_router.py) per your >700-line guideline.
POST /api/prototype/graphs returns 200 for a resource creation — RESTfully it should be 201.
PrototypeStudio.jsx handleRun sets a 8s setInterval poll but never clears it on component unmount — potential memory/stale-state leak if user navigates away mid-run.
PrototypeStudio.jsx uses raw axios instead of the shared api client in /lib/api.js — inconsistent with other pages (DRY).
handleSave uses empty catch — no error surface beyond generic toast. Same 'silent catch' pattern flagged in prior iterations.

Cloudinary uploader is invoked synchronously (cloudinary.uploader.upload) inside an async endpoint — blocks the event loop for the duration of the upload. Consider running via asyncio.to_thread or aiohttp-based Cloudinary SDK.
prototype_engine.py imports uuid twice (module-level + inside run_prototype_panel).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ProtoFlow, TEST_ToDelete, TEST_ProtoFlow_Renamed via API; also created & deleted TEST_UI_Flow via UI save. All cleaned up post-test.
